desc:
Bring your small dog or cat along for walks, vet visits and train rides. The Orlivane Pet Sling has a deep soft pouch, a wide adjustable strap and a collar clip, and it folds flat when you don't need it.

Specifications:
- Material: soft fabric
- For pets up to about 15 lb (7 kg)
- Strap: wide, adjustable
- Safety: collar clip
- Color: gray
b: HANDS-FREE — Wear it over one shoulder and keep your small dog or cat close while both hands stay free for errands, walks and bus rides.
COLLAR CLIP — The built-in clip attaches to your pet's collar to help keep them inside the pouch.
WIDE ADJUSTABLE STRAP — The wide strap spreads the weight across your shoulder. Adjust it to wear the sling higher or lower.
DEEP, SOFT POUCH — Soft fabric gives your pet room to curl up and is gentle on paws.
FOLDS FLAT — Fold it up and pack it into a tote. Sized for small pets up to about 15 lb (7 kg); check your pet's weight and length before ordering. Color: gray.
